description: adult woman demiurge, the maker of worlds, an archmage, tall, long dark brown hair, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, the highest and most epic form of all, even richer and more splendid than a god, flowing robes like the night sky in which new stars are being born, four tiny worlds of fire, ice, storm and stone circling close around the body, a crown of clear crystal, holding a tall ornate staff topped with a small blazing sun, the whole staff inside the image, awe-inspiring, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same woman: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, even more epic outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
